title: Executive Director, Brazil
description:
Description

Role: Executive Director, Brazil

Modality: Onsite

Place: Op Smile Brazil

City: Sao Paulo

Language Requirements: Required - English and Portuguese, Spanish preferred.

General Description:

The Executive Director (ED) is the primary representative of the organization in the country, responsible for the overall supervision of all operations, finances, fundraising, human resources, and programs. This role encompasses a wide range of responsibilities, from strategic and financial management to program oversight and relationship management with key stakeholders.

The ED will work closely with the regional team and Operation Smile International (OSI) headquarters, ensuring that national programs are implemented according to global standards and in the required direction so that the foundation's goals are achieved. The Executive Director is responsible for leading the strategy, budgets, and operations of the foundation, aligning them with organizational and regional objectives. They act as a key liaison with volunteers, donors, governments, and local and international partners, promoting Operation Smile's mission in all activities.

Main Functions:

1. Strategy and Vision:

  • Develop a clear strategic direction in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders, aligned with the global organization's vision and mission.
  • Plan and formulate short- and long-term strategies for the foundation's growth in the country, aligning local objectives with OSI global goals.
  • Ensure the implementation of national programs according to Operation Smile's international care standards and maintain continuous impact evaluation.
  • Explore and evaluate new funding and expansion opportunities, presenting initiatives that strengthen the foundation's impact in the country.
  • Implement a sustainable and robust management system to timely monitor and report results to all relevant stakeholders.

2. Project and Program Management:

  • Oversee the planning and implementation of surgical and health programs, ensuring they are developed with adequate resources and executed within established timelines and budgets.
  • Conduct annual monitoring and evaluation of programs, adjusting strategies as needed to improve outcomes.
  • Coordinate with the regional team to ensure compliance with OSI care standards in local programs.
  • Develop monitoring and evaluation systems to ensure program quality and effectiveness.

3. Financial Management and Compliance:

  • Coordinate with the Regional Finance Director and local finance team to manage and oversee the country's operational and programmatic budget.
  • Review and validate departmental budgets, ensuring financial resources are used efficiently and aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Manage cash flow and ensure proper use of funds, complying with local tax regulations and donor requirements.
  • Prepare quarterly and monthly financial reports for OSI and other stakeholders, ensuring transparency and compliance with financial standards.

4. Governance and Board Management:

  • Organize and lead monthly meetings with the Board of Directors, providing detailed financial, programmatic, and operational reports.
  • Ensure the Board of Directors is fully informed about the progress of the annual budget and the achievement of strategic objectives.
  • Provide accurate and detailed documentation for review and approval by the Board and ensure complete and accurate records of meetings are maintained.

5. People and Human Resources Management:

  • Recruit, motivate, and manage a skilled and committed team, promoting a culture of excellence, innovation, and collaboration.
  • Implement human resources policies that ensure proper workforce planning, professional development, and staff well-being.
  • Foster a positive work environment based on continuous learning and performance improvement, establishing clear and effective performance evaluation systems.

6. Volunteer Management:

  • Work with local and regional volunteer leaders to ensure the recruitment and active participation of volunteers in the foundation's programs.
  • Promote volunteer participation in local and international activities, ensuring a valuable and meaningful experience for them.
  • Provide support and guidance to international volunteers participating in local programs.

7. External Relations and Fundraising:

  • Represent the organization to donors, partners, media, and other key stakeholders, both nationally and internationally.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships with the Ministry of Health, local governments, hospitals, NGOs, and other relevant partners.
  • Lead fundraising activities, ensuring the financial sustainability of programs and promoting active participation from private and institutional donors.
  • Monitor results on a consistent basis.

8. Security and Risk Management:

  • Manage the security of the organization's staff and assets, ensuring compliance with local and global security regulations.
  • Establish links with local security officials and other stakeholders to manage risks and ensure a safe environment for the team and programs.

Requirements

Experience Required (education/work):

  • University degree in Public Health, Health Science, Business Administration, Project Management, Information Science, or other relevant fields.
  • At least 10 years of experience with increasing responsibility in management positions, preferably within international non-profit organizations.
  • Working experience with high level government officials, internal and external stakeholders, and partners.
  • Demonstrable management of workforce and HR requirements.
  • Track record of working with charity and society organization and its compliance.

Competencies:

  • Leadership, with prior experience in leading diverse teams.
  • Proven experience implementing and sustaining a robust management system, integrating processes, procedures, and performance metrics to drive transparency and operational effectiveness.
  • Strong administrative and project management skills.
  • Proven knowledge of fiscal concepts, demonstrating the ability to plan, manage, and execute budgets.
  • Strong implementation skills, specifically with programs.
  • Understanding of the country's healthcare environment and the challenges posed by the system.
  • Highly organized and motivated.
  • Proficiency in oral, written, and presentation skills in English.
  • Advanced level in Spanish, oral and written.
  • Ability to work diplomatically in a global team-based environment that includes board members, medical professionals, and volunteers.
  • Ability to take on new projects or tasks as needed.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Senior Embedded Products and Software Reliability Engineer
description:
Reliability Consulting Engineer - Protection and Control

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Job Description Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Reliability Consulting Engineer with a strong background in protection and control systems, energy management devices, and utility-scale software for transmission and distribution (T&D) applications.

Job Description Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Reliability Consulting Engineer with a strong background in protection and control systems, energy management devices, and utility-scale software for transmission and distribution (T&D) applications.
In this role, you will lead reliability initiatives across the lifecycle of critical grid automation products, including protection relays, control devices, digital substation solutions, and advanced software platforms. You will apply best-in-class reliability engineering methodologies to ensure system resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term field performance. Your work will directly support utility customers in achieving higher uptime, reduced lifecycle costs, and safer grid operation.
Job Description
Key Responsibilities

  • Perform reliability modeling and statistical analysis of energy management and protection/control products to predict field performance and act as authority for reliability design decisions.
  • Develop and execute reliability test plans for hardware and software, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), environmental, and stress testing for grid components.
  • Conduct and lead FMEA, FMECA, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for hardware/software failure events across embedded systems and communication layers.
  • Work with product design, systems engineering, and software teams to ensure Design for Reliability (DfR) is embedded from concept through deployment.
  • Analyze field data from deployed devices (e.g., relays, RTUs, control systems) to identify systemic issues and recommend corrective/preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with utilities and customers to support grid asset performance programs and grid modernization initiatives, including IEC 61850, virtualization, and advanced diagnostics.
  • Develop and maintain reliability KPIs (e.g., MTBF, FIT rate, availability) for product lines and integrate into product development and quality programs.
  • Identify and drive adoption of predictive and condition-based maintenance strategies using remote diagnostics, SCADA, and sensor data.
  • Consult and align with the Innovation Office and Applications team to ensure reliability priorities influence working group participation, standards leadership, and technology strategy.
  • Stay current on regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., NERC, IEEE, IEC standards) impacting utility asset reliability and cybersecurity.
  • Provide coaching, training, and guidance on reliability practices to internal teams and external stakeholders.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in reliability, systems, or product engineering in the energy or utility sector.
Desired Characteristics
  • Familiar with protection & control systems, grid-edge devices, substation automation, and utility-grade software solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with reliability engineering tools and standards (e.g., ReliaSoft, ISO 9001/55000, IEC 61025).
  • Familiarity with communications protocols and standards used in T&D systems: IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEEE C37.118, etc.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis platforms (e.g., Python, R, Minitab, Power BI).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to engage cross-functional teams and utility customers.
  • Understanding of grid reliability challenges in T&D environments & willingness to travel for customer engagements, conferences, and global collaboration.
  • Collaborative leadership across engineering, field teams, and customers
  • Data-driven problem-solving mindset with attention to long-term product health including systems thinking
  • Proactive approach to emerging technologies and continuous improvement
  • Master’s degree in Reliability or Systems Engineering.
  • Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) or similar professional certification.
  • Familiar with model-based design and HIL testing (e.g., RTDS, PSCAD, or EMTP) for utility applications and simulation tools used in electronics and CAD design
  • Experience working directly with T&D utilities, supporting product deployments, failure investigations, or asset strategies.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity risk and reliability considerations for critical infrastructure.
This role is expected to close on 7/21/25.

description:
Community Engineer (multiple roles and seniority levels)

Community Engineer (multiple roles and seniority levels)

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Community Engineer (multiple roles and seniority levels) role at Canonical

Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence when it comes to serving the open source ecosystem. This is your chance to be a part of that as a Community Engineer at Canonical .
We are building community management at scale. We have multiple positions available, at different seniority levels.
All applications and candidates are handled through this single entry point.
The role of a Community Engineer
The Community team at Canonical enables community leaders and participants to get things done, co-ordinating with Canonical teams and ensuring that community processes are efficient and well run. We don't do the work of the community, but we facilitate that work to ensure that energetic and ambitious community members with their own vision of open source can benefit from the work Canonical does and bring their own flavor of Ubuntu into being, to meet the needs and express the interests of their community. You will play a key role in designing, executing, and scaling initiatives that foster a thriving community.
This is an exciting opportunity for a technically proficient person who is passionate about open source software, Linux, and sustainable community building.
In this role, you will support community initiatives with your technical skills and strong organizational skills. You work hand in hand with developers to smooth processes and integrate community plans with Canonical plans for maximum impact. You can encourage and facilitate the creation of new technical projects that enhance the community contribution experience, and you represent community interests to Canonical teams. You will lead complex, multi-disciplinary programs from conception through launch, working closely with Developer Relations engineers, technical authors, product managers, marketing teams, engineering teams, and external partners.
You will support and engage with volunteer developers in the Ubuntu community, addressing their concerns and helping them to create successful tools. You will help to ensure their success and the overall autonomy and sustainability of projects.
You will provide the content and technical support to ensure the community stays engaged and informed. This will include regular blog and social media posts about community initiatives, events, accomplishments, and collaborative efforts between Canonical and the Ubuntu community.
You will communicate effectively with developers and software engineers and represent not only the Ubuntu community but Canonical as a contributor to the wider Linux ecosystem. Our team attends conferences and expos, and talks about technical community projects and their development processes.
Location : These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
What your day will look like

  • Write high quality content to promote and support community initiatives
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions to community problems
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
  • Potential opportunity to travel more if you wish
  • Nurture community contributions to Ubuntu
  • Engage with the Ubuntu community through Discourse, Matrix, social media, conferences, etc.
  • Represent Ubuntu via speaking engagements at events and conferences
  • Support the engagement by Canonical teams into the open source ecosystem
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have experience with developer tools and open source projects
  • You have a clear public record of accomplishments (talks, blog posts, GitHub, X, etc.)
  • You have interest and experience with some of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, DevOps, software development, testing and QA, package management, container technology
  • You can work autonomously and assume full ownership of objectives as needed
  • You can be flexible with your time and enjoy working with new technology in a fast-paced environment
  • You are experienced working with open source communities and understand the workflow of volunteer contributors
  • You have experience in (technical) program management and have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Experience with community management
  • Experience with Developer advocacy
  • Experience as a software developer
  • Examples of contributions to the Ubuntu Community
  • Experience with contributing to open source projects
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

No Brasil, por meio da Mosaic Fertilizantes, opera na mineração, produção, importação, comercialização e distribuição de fertilizantes para aplicação em diversas culturas agrícolas, ingredientes para nutrição animal e produtos industriais. Descrição

Você irá avaliar e/ou fiscalizar as condições físicas e operacionais dos equipamentos em instalações no complexo, através das inspeções dinâmicas, analisando os resultados, elaborando relatórios e recomendações de reparos que se façam necessários, visando garantir a integridade física dos equipamentos, a segurança e a continuidade operacional.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Efetuar, testemunhar e fiscalizar a inspeção de equipamentos, tubulações e instalações, em qualquer uma das fases de fabricação, recebimento, montagem, operação, interpretando e registrando resultados, a fim de garantir o cumprimento dos padrões técnicos.
  • Avaliar o grau de deterioração em equipamentos, tubulações e instalações, identificando causas e efeitos, permitindo ações preventivas e corretivas e garantindo a integridade dos equipamentos e continuidade operacional.
  • Elaborar relatórios, descrevendo os defeitos e avarias e elaborar recomendações de inspeção, dentro das normas técnicas, a fim de indicar intervenções de manutenção necessárias.
  • Realizar e acompanhar testes diversos, exames e controles de monitorações, interpretando e registrando os resultados observados, a fim de identificar causas de avarias.
  • Criar e manter registros confiáveis e atualizados das inspeções efetuadas, a fim de manter histórico.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar a implantação de instruções técnicas, programas e planos de inspeção e rotas em equipamentos diversos e instalações, a fim de atender as Normas Regulamentadoras e necessidades técnicas para garantir a disponibilidade dos equipamentos.
  • Efetuar o controle de qualidade na execução dos trabalhos de manutenção, fabricação, construção, montagem e inspeção, utilizando-se dos ensaios não destrutivos e técnicas diversas, a fim de monitorar o grau de confiabilidade desejado.
  • Monitorar e averiguar os instrumentos de inspeção quanto a sua calibração e aferição, bem como na sua manutenção, a fim de manter a conservação e assegurar a confiabilidade dos resultados.
  • Realizar e acompanhar a coleta de amostras e corpos de provas de materiais, a fim de encaminhar para análise.
  • Investigar as causas das falhas, elaborando e implantando plano de ação para tratativa das ocorrências que interromperam a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para a produção.
  • Elaborar e ministrar treinamentos referentes a execução dos planos, procedimentos e técnicas de manutenção e inspeção.
  • Eventualmente, executar atividades de manutenção de equipamentos programadas no campo; e realizar planejamento e programação de atividades de manutenção programadas alocando todos os recursos necessários.

Esta posição se reporta ao Coordenador de Engenharia de Manutenção.

Desejável:

RÉSUMÉ DU POSTE
Le/la responsable de la logistique fournit des services et un soutien logistiques, conformément aux politiques et procédures d'International Medical Corps ainsi qu'aux réglementations des donateurs et du pays hôte. Le/la responsable de la logistique soutient les activités logistiques au niveau du bureau, y compris l'entretien des bâtiments et les achats associés, la gestion des stocks du bureau, la gestion de la flotte et, si nécessaire, les actifs et le support informatique.
Pour mener à bien ce travail, une personne doit être capable de remplir chaque fonction essentielle avec ou sans aménagements raisonnables.
PRINCIPALES TÂCHES ET RESPONSABILITÉS
Gestion du bureau

  • Point focal pour toutes les activités logistiques quotidiennes du bureau et leur suivi .
  • Soutenir le lancement des demandes d'achat et la collecte des offres pour les achats liés au fonctionnement du bureau (entretien, approvisionnement en carburant, nettoyage, fournitures de bureau, etc.). S'assurer que tous les contrats/commandes sont correctement suivis et renouvelés en temps opportun, si nécessaire, auprès du service des achats.
  • Responsable des stocks de fournitures de bureau et des rapports y afférents.
  • Assurer la liaison avec le propriétaire de l'installation pour tout entretien et amélioration de l'espace.
  • Veiller à ce que le bureau soit correctement entretenu.
  • S'assurer que le bureau dispose des équipements de sécurité requis, en étroite collaboration avec le-la responsable de la sûreté et de la sécurité.
Gestion de la flotte
  • Aide à compiler les emplois du temps fournis par tous les services sur une base hebdomadaire
  • Planifier les déplacements hebdomadaires en conséquence et assigner les plannings aux conducteur(trice)s en conséquence.
  • Gère de près les déplacements quotidiens et assure le ravitaillement en carburant en temps opportun des véhicules et des générateurs.
  • Prendre en charge l'orientation des conducteur(trice)s , les briefings sur la sûreté et la sécurité.
Informations et technologies
  • Fournit un soutien au service informatique, selon les besoins, dans :
  • La création de compte pour les nouveaux utilisateurs
  • Le dépannage de base
Connecter des appareils
  • Rapports logistiques
  • Aider à préparer les rapports logistiques comme demandé par le/la directeur(trice)
Gestion des actifs
Le/la responsable de la logistique pourrait être amené(e) à servir de point focal des actifs avec les responsabilités ci-dessous.
  • Mettre en œuvre les politiques et procédures de gestion des actifs d’IMC.
  • Responsable de la gestion des actifs sur le site de terrain respectif sur la base des procédures de gestion des actifs d’IMC.
  • Veiller à ce que chaque actif et article attrayant soit enregistré, émis avec un identifiant d'actif unique d’IMC, attribué au dépositaire et suivi conformément aux procédures de gestion des actifs.
  • Documente l’ensemble des transactions ou changements de statut liés aux actifs.
  • Fournir un soutien à la direction dans les tâches liées aux actifs.
  • Soutenir la direction dans le rapprochement mensuel, sur la base des informations générées par les rapports Cognos automatisés indiquant que tous les actifs achetés ont été enregistrés dans la liste des actifs et que les informations financières sont consignées avec précision par les documents de sauvegarde des bons correspondants.
  • S'assurer que tous les actifs/éléments attrayants sous sa responsabilité sont confiés au dépositaire qui est un(e) employé(e) actif(ve).
  • Responsable du transfert documenté vers/depuis le dépositaire, en coordination avec les services concernés (par exemple, les RH pour le personnel nouvellement embauché/les licenciements).
  • Contrôler régulièrement l'exactitude des informations de la liste des actifs, de leur statut et du dépositaire.
  • Signaler à l'équipe de direction tout élément identifié comme manquant/perdu à des fins d’enquête (lorsque les raisons ne sont pas connues).
  • Initier les demandes de maintenance des actifs, le cas échéant.
  • Introduire une demande d'évaluation et d'élimination des articles inutilisables dès leur signalement.
  • Commencer l'évaluation de l'article nécessitant une réparation et en assurer le suivi jusqu'à la réparation.
  • S'assurer que l'élimination des articles est approuvée et documentée et que la documentation est partagée avec la direction pour communication ultérieure au bureau logistique.
  • Soutenir la direction pour organiser des contrôles ponctuels et un inventaire complet.
  • Avant de soumettre la demande d'assurance, examiner la liste des articles y afférents et s'assurer que les demandes sont accompagnées de toutes les pièces justificatives requises.
  • Agir au nom du service des actifs lorsque cela est demandé.
  • Effectue d'autres activités liées à la gestion des actifs comme indiqué. Prévention de la fraude
  • S'engage à prévenir, détecter, signaler et réduire les risques de fraude, conformément aux politiques et procédures d’IMC, aux règles des donateurs et aux lois et réglementations locales.
  • Maintient des systèmes de classement précis, avec des enregistrements documentés et vérifiables des transactions d'approvisionnement et des rapports/suivi.
Effectuer les autres tâches qui lui sont confiées. Les fonctions et responsabilités énumérées dans le présent document sont représentatives de la nature et du volume du travail assigné et ne sont pas nécessairement exhaustives.
Qualifications Minimales
  • Généralement, un diplôme de baccalauréat en logistique, chaîne logistique, gestion des transports. Une combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience pertinentes peut être acceptée le cas échéant.
  • Généralement, plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans la logistique.
  • Bonnes compétences relationnelles et esprit d'équipe.
  • Engagement et compréhension des objectifs, valeurs et principes d'IMC.
  • Connaissance de MS Office, y compris MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint et Outlook.
  • Capacité à bien s’intégrer et travailler au sein d’équipes multiethniques et multiculturelles.
  • Capacité à travailler dans des conditions difficiles, souvent dans des zones reculées, souhaitable.
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais à l’écrit et à l’oral
  • Diplômes ou cours de formation pertinents.

title: Especialista de Inteligência de Mercado Regional - Trul Hoteis
description:
Sobre Nós:

O prazer é todo nosso ; )

Cada hotel tem uma característica especial. Muitas vezes, o grande desafio é encontrar qual e desenvolver o seu potencial. Por isso, a Trul é a primeira operadora multimarcas de Minas Gerais a aplicar o conceito de Customização Hoteleira. O que, em outras palavras, significa entender o que um hotel tem de melhor para, assim, desenvolver marcas e experiências únicas para o hóspede.

A Trul é detalhista e completa: cuida da implantação à operação hoteleira. Acompanha cada detalhe para garantir a gestão eficiente e necessária para atrair clientes e, claro, criar motivos para que eles voltem sempre. =)

Descrição:

Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de precificação e receitas dos hotéis, acompanhando o comportamento do mercado, concorrentes e perfil dos hóspedes, visando gerar lucro para os empreendimentos.

Atividades:

  • Analisar e monitorar o mercado e os concorrentes, usando as informações do set competitivo, acompanhando hábitos de compra dos hóspedes em relação ao empreendimento, para determinar as melhores estratégias de precificação;
  • Acompanhar as tendências e avanços tecnológicos do setor através da pesquisa de mercado, análise dos concorrentes e networking, visando a otimização dos processos e melhoria na receita.
  • Estabelecer, em parceria com o departamento comercial, estratégias para o fechamento de vendas do empreendimento, objetivando alcançar os melhores resultados e garantir a satisfação dos hóspedes.
  • Realizar a previsão das receitas futuras do empreendimento com base no histórico de vendas, levando em consideração o volume de faturamento do hotel, visando planejar com antecedência as estratégias de vendas, marketing e operação, bem como identificar oportunidades de crescimento, minimizar riscos financeiros e apoiar na tomada de decisão.
  • Elaborar indicadores do departamento, para acompanhar e monitorar o desempenho das estratégias de precificação e gestão de receitas do empreendimento.
  • Conduzir o processo de onboarding da área, garantindo que os novos colaboradores recebam toda a orientação necessária para desempenhar suas funções corretamente;
  • Manter um bom relacionamento com os demais setores da empresa, buscando a integração e colaboração entre as áreas;
  • Participar da implantação de novos hotéis na central de reservas, colaborando no desenvolvimento de processos e procedimentos;
  • Participar de reuniões com a diretoria para apresentar os indicadores do departamento e contribuir na elaboração de estratégias.

Para a vaga consideramos necessário:

  • Ensino Superior completo;
  • Experiência em RM;
  • Atuação na área hoteleira;
  • Experiência em PMS: Opera Cloud, Totvs (Vhf, Thex).
  • Pacote Office avançado.

Para a vaga consideramos desejável:

  • Graduação em gestão hoteleira/turismo ou afins;
  • Vivência em hotéis de rede;

Para a vaga consideramos diferencial:

  • Conhecimentos em outros idiomas além do inglês;
  • Pós-graduação em negócios, pessoas, hotelaria.

O que oferecemos:

  • Day off;
  • Wellhub;
  • Descontos de 50% de hospedagem nos hotéis da rede;

title: Lead Turbine Design Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary

The turbine lead Engineer should be the technical person responsible for turbine mechanical design coordination in a project execution . He will be responsible to give ll all the need technical support not only to the engineering team but also to the other cross functional areas.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Be the technical person in charge of hydro turbine mechanical design on a new or refurbishment project, supported by Principal/Consulting Engineers.
  • Analyze technical information from Work Packages (Technical Specifications, Division of Work) and participate in identifying the risks and opportunities of the project on technical matters.
  • Plan and follow project engineering basic design phase and coordinate with Hydraulic design team (hydraulic test lab) and Special Calculation team.
  • Perform designs and calculations of turbine components and validate critical ones with Principal/Consulting Engineers.
  • Direct and manage design reviews, perform design review actions follow-up.
  • Provide technical support to the customer in coordination with the project System Integrator.
  • Prepare information for the execution of technical drawings and supervise and validate the draftsman work.
  • Optimize designs with Supply Chain, Site Installation to get the lowest installed equipment costs.
  • Write reports and engineering documents, including test procedures, engineering calculation notes, operation and maintenance manuals.
  • Occasionally conduct site visits to assess the existing turbine and participate to signature tests on the unit before disassembly at site.
  • Provide technical support to Supply Chain and to Site Installation team (erection and commissioning) of sub-assemblies / components under your responsibility.
  • Follow up the performance testing of the prototype turbine on site.
  • Develop tools and design guides for turbine engineering.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering including a minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in mechanical design.
  • Experience with NX, AutoCad and/or SolidWorks .
  • Demonstrate technical leadership.
  • Ability to work in a team and communicate effectively.
  • Must be willing to comply with pre-employment screening, including but not limited, reference verification and background check.
  • Availability for occasional travel, in Brazil, Canada and USA.
  • Willingness to develop in-depth knowledge of hydro technical discipline using prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in both Portuguese and English (French is a plus).
  • Interact fluidly with colleagues in our other facilities across and/or outside Brazil, and who are generally unable to communicate in Portuguese and whose language at work is predominantly English.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Ability to influence others and lead small teams.
  • Ability to coordinate several mandates simultaneously.
  • Effective problem identification and solution skills.
  • Proven analytical and organizational ability.

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

description:
Olá somos a Gralha Azul Portas, Madeiras e ACM Premium Door, nascemos em 1991 e desde 2020 estamos em pleno crescimento e evolução. Somos uma empresa dinâmica, que adora mudanças e promove melhorias em nossos processos. Topamos os desafios que aparecem no decorrer da nossa jornada de peito aberto e cada erro aqui é uma possibilidade de acerto. Nosso objetivo é daqui a um ano olhar para a Gralha e ver como evoluímos. Aqui o Cliente é a prioridade número um e fazemos nosso melhor por ele. Se você é dinâmico, gosta de desafios novos e adora mudanças, você vai se identificar com nossa cultura!

Para esse cargo precisamos que:

Assegure o cumprimento das obrigações fiscais e contábeis da empresa, garantindo a conformidade com as leis e regulamentos tributários, bem como otimizando a carga tributária dentro dos limites legais.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Apuração e Contabilização de Impostos: realizar a apuração e contabilização dos impostos diretos e indiretos, como ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ORPJ e CSLL, de acordo com as normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes.
  2. Elaboração de obrigações acessórias: preparar e entregar as obrigações acessórias exigidas pelos órgãos governamentais, SPED Fiscal, EFD contribuições, DCTF, DIRF, entre outras, dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.

  4. Planejamento tributário: colaborar no desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias de planejamento tributário, visando otimizar a carga tributária da empresa de forma legal e ética.
  5. Atendimento a fiscalizações: prestar suporte durante fiscalizações tributárias, fornecendo informações e documentos solicitados pelos auditores e auxiliando na resolução de eventuais pendências.
  6. Análise de Contratos e Operações: analisar contratos e operações da empresa para identificar possíveis impactos tributários e propor soluções que minimizem riscos e maximizem benefícios fiscais.
  7. Gestão de Certidões e parcelamentos: gerenciar a obtenção e renovação de certidões negativas de débitos e parcelamentos fiscais, garantindo a regularidade fiscal da empresa.

REQUISITOS:

  • Formação em Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em contabilidade e tributação, preferencialmente em empresas ou escritórios de contabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido em legislação tributária e normas contábeis.
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de ERP e ferramentas de gestão fiscal.
  • Habilidade analítica e capacidade de resolver problemas complexos.
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.

As Workplace Experience Partner ll you will keep the São Paulo Publishing Office and eSports Arena rolling and cultivate a space where all Rioters can thrive. You will be responsible for assisting the Americas Region Workplace Experience Manager in all aspects of local operations management and program management within the scope of workplace experience as well as being the primary point of contact for the São Paulo Publishing Office and eSports Arena.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage the overall inner-workings of the Riot office and arena. Partner with stakeholders such as local Riot leadership, building management, WE team, and Physical Security to develop and enact programs that maximize workplace effectiveness. Ensure the established budget is maintained and work to hold vendors accountable within budgetary constraints.
  • Manage local vendor and/or supplier relationships to ensure WE contractors perform day-to-day responsibilities and continue to meet Riot standards. Coordinate with on-site physical security as needed.
  • Monitor for and oversee maintenance and repairs, closely aligning with local and WE leadership. Monitor and improve office and arena environments to adhere to WE standards.
  • Partner with local leadership to drive effective Workplace Experience programs and provide insight on workplace needs.
  • Welcome visitors and out-of-town Rioters to the office. Allocate and log visitor passes to the office and help out-of-town Rioters with temporary badge access. Support creation of any workplace experience-related processes for the eSports arena.
  • Support space planning and workplace moves by collaborating with Rioters to understand their needs and executing necessary changes. Ensure the workspace is optimized to enable teams to operate effectively and deliver high value to our players.
  • Perform environmental health and safety (EHS) compliance activities and maintain and optimize office procedure documentation.
  • Support local office events and large-scale initiatives, including esports tournaments and cultural celebrations that reflect Brazilian holidays and traditions. Responsibilities include event planning, communications, vendor coordination, and on-site support to drive employee engagement and a strong sense of belonging.
  • Support regional operations, including recruiting coordination, employer branding and marketing initiatives, and managing travel logistics for local Rioters. This includes handling travel arrangements and collaborating with travel agencies to ensure smooth and cost-effective travel experiences.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience of providing facilities or maintenance service in a busy organization.
  • Experience managing contractors and suppliers, including monitoring service standards and ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures. Strong negotiation skills are essential for vendor management and contract discussions.
  • Comprehensive understanding of Brazilian labor law (CLT), particularly in adapting workplace practices to remain compliant.
  • Events management expertise with the ability to deliver high-quality, compliant experiences.
  • Strong work ethic with the ability to take initiative, function in a fast-paced working environment, with immediate and changing deadlines.
  • Ability to prioritize workload, with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and time management are a must.
  • Demonstrated strong and effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to interact comfortably and effectively with managers and employees at all levels within our company.
  • Fluency in English
  • Ability to operate independently and proactively with little or no supervision.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes your fellow Rioters, who are the customers of your work. Being a dedicated fan of games is not necessary for this position!

Our Perks:

We offer medical, dental, and vision plans that cover you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children. Life insurance, parental leave, plus short-term and long-term disability coverage are also available. Riot will support your retirement benefits with a company match, and double down on your donations of time and money to non-profit charitable organizations. Balance between work and personal life is encouraged with open paid time off, and a play fund so you can broaden and deepen your personal relationship with games.

Because together we are better

It's our policy to provide equal employment opportunities for all applicants and members of Riot Games. We know that fresh and varied perspectives will make us better at what we do, so however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, we're excited to hear from you. Don't be discouraged if you feel you don't fully meet every single one of the requirements for a particular role, there's always room for growth at. Riot. If this role excites you and aligns with your passion for entertainment and live production, we’re eager to hear from you.

Hard Skills
  • Advanced proficiency in paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads)

title: Freelance Credit Research Analyst – Latin America
description:
Freelance Credit Research Analyst – Latin America

We're looking for an experienced credit research analyst to join our Debtwire Credit Research Team. The team provides unique insights and valuation analysis on companies and their securities that are restructuring, in the process of a transforming event or raising capital. Key tasks will include reviewing financial statements and legal documents to produce detailed credit research on stressed, distressed, and restructuring companies. The analysis will be produced in reports produced for subscribers of Debtwire, an ION Analytics subsidiary.

You will have the option to work remotely, including a flexible contract and competitive rates.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Produce Credit Reports that provide financial and valuation analysis on high-yield, distressed and stressed companies.
  • Interact with subscribers electronically and personally to discuss credit and macro analysis.
  • Along with creating credit research, the candidate will assist in special reports and ad-hoc projects.
  • Interact with management and IR teams of companies covered. Attend conferences and company investor day as needed.

Required Skills, Experience, and Qualifications

  • The candidate should have 5+ years as either a credit or equity analyst.
  • Naturally curious and driven to figure out how to analyze complex situations and be tenacious in obtaining information.
  • Excellent understanding of financial statements: income statement, balance sheet and cash flows and the drive to thoroughly read the information supporting the financial statements.
  • A thorough understanding of debt and equity securities and the markets they trade in is required, including some knowledge of bankruptcy processes.
  • Valuation experience including waterfall, and DCF analysis is required.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of fixed income analytics (ie Z-spread, duration).
  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish (both strongly preferred).
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Excel and Word
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to build a thesis and reach a conclusion in a structured manner, are required.
  • Experience writing reports in English.
  • Ability to work in a team-based environment, with a sense of teamwork and cooperation
  • Ability to manage workflow under strict deadlines
About us

We’re a diverse group of visionary innovators who provide trading and workflow automation software, high-value analytics, and strategic consulting to corporations, central banks, financial institutions, and governments. Founded in 1999, we’ve achieved tremendous growth by bringing together some of the best and most successful financial technology companies in the world.

• Over 2,000 of the world’s leading corporations, including 50% of the Fortune 500 and 30% of the world’s central banks, trust ION solutions to manage their cash, in-house banking, commodity supply chain, trading and risk.

• Over 800 of the world’s leading banks and broker-dealers use our electronic trading platforms to operate the world’s financial market infrastructure.

ION is a rapidly expanding and dynamic group with 13,000 employees and offices in more than 40 cities around the globe. Our ever-expanding global footprint, cutting edge products, and over 40,000 customers worldwide provide an unparalleled career experience for those who share our vision.

ION is committed to maintaining a supportive and inclusive environment for people with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We respect the varied identities, abilities, cultures, and traditions of the individuals who comprise our organization and recognize the value that different backgrounds and points of view bring to our business.

Why You’ll Like Working Here

description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Marketing at TRACTIAN:

The Marketing team at TRACTIAN crafts the narrative, defines messaging and positioning, and translates our groundbreaking products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our cross-functional team, spanning Product Marketing, Customer Experience, Growth, Branding, and Events, is dedicated to acquiring new customers and possesses a deep understanding of the business. We collaborate closely with a lot of teams to elucidate how we can help our clients reach their full potential.

What you'll do:

As our Content Manager, you’ll be responsible for driving our regional content strategy from planning to execution. This includes managing our editorial calendar, optimizing performance across key channels, and ensuring alignment with business goals. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Growth, and Sales to create high-impact content that supports inbound acquisition, ABM campaigns, and customer education.

This is a hands-on and strategic role, ideal for someone who combines editorial excellence, technical affinity, and a performance mindset.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the content calendar for Brazil across blogs, landing pages, partner media, newsletters, and outbound campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain a consistent pipeline of high-performing content assets that support the full funnel: awareness, education, and conversion.
  • Lead localization and adaptation of content created by the US and MX teams, ensuring cultural and technical relevance.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and Sales to produce BOFU assets such as comparison pages, customer case studies, and playbooks.
  • Support ABM and demand generation initiatives with tailored content aligned with target accounts.
  • Track and analyze content performance metrics to inform future production and optimization.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external writers or partners to scale output without losing quality.
  • Partner with the SEO team to ensure all content supports our growth strategy and aligns with keyword opportunities.
,

  • 5+ years of experience managing B2B content, ideally in SaaS or industrial technology
  • Proven ability to lead editorial planning and coordinate content workflows across multiple teams
  • Strong writing and editing skills, especially in simplifying technical topics
  • Experience with SEO tools (e.g. Semrush, Ahrefs) and CMS platforms
  • Data-driven mindset, with experience measuring content impact on traffic, leads, and pipeline
  • Highly autonomous, organized, and deadline-driven
  • Advanced English

  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses

description:
We're quickly growing and super excited for you to join us!

It’s a sports team that’s hyper focused on winning, collaborative internally, and competitive externally - never the other way around. We thrive on working in the open, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. Your solutions won’t just be functional—they’ll be impactful and user-friendly, strengthening long-term customer relationships.

If you enjoymeeting people, collaborating in person, and making an impact globally ,this is the role for you!

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. We thrive on working together, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

  • Direct and Speedy: we move quickly, experiment boldly, and get things done today, not tomorrow. Feedback is candid, and the drive for constant improvement is part of our DNA.

  • Embrace a Sports Team Mentality: We're only competitive externally, and very collaborative internally. Everyone plays a vital role, and together, we win as a team.
  • Silicon Valley to the World: Founded by Stanford and Harvard alumni during the pandemic, we offer flexible working arrangements and (at least) one in-person offsite gathering per year to stay connected as a team.

Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, criatividade, liderança, proatividade, comprometimento, flexibilidade, colaboração, resiliência, curiosidade, capacidade analítica, diferentes perfis e investimos nas fortalezas individuais.

As oportunidades poderão ser no formato híbrido ou remoto, conforme a necessidade de cada área.

Se você se identifica com a LCA, cadastre-se no nosso Banco de Talentos e lembre-se de manter o seu perfil atualizado. Fazemos uma triagem entre currículos cadastrados toda vez que uma vaga é aberta; reforçamos, porém, que alguns currículos podem acabar não sendo selecionados nessa triagem e a atualização do perfil também envolve a candidatura a vagas específicas.

Importante: por se tratar de um Banco de Talentos, não temos nenhuma previsão definitiva de quando a posição será aberta. Por isso, fique atento aos canais de comunicação.

A LCA é a maior consultoria econômica do Brasil. Atende clientes nacionais e internacionais nas áreas de finanças e em análises econômicas que envolvem regulação, políticas públicas, litígios, entre outros.

São aproximadamente 50 economistas, que atuam de forma integrada, agregando sinergias para o desenvolvimento de trabalhos de excelência.

Somos a única consultoria da América Latina ranqueada no Global Competition Review 100 e no Latin Lawyer 250.

Atribuímos o nosso sucesso à equipe, que une habilidades diversificadas e engajamento no trabalho em equipe.

O envolvimento em projetos é profundo, completo e imediato. O treinamento é na realidade. O ambiente é colaborativo, você sempre terá o suporte de todos.

Buscamos sempre construir um ótimo lugar para trabalhar e valorizamos o equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Respeitamos a individualidade e damos muita atenção a situações pessoais.

Atuamos pela diversidade e inclusão na LCA

A LCA valoriza a diversidade e incentiva a candidatura de pessoas que fazem parte dos grupos subrepresentados no mercado de trabalho: mulheres, pessoas negras, LGBTQIA+, PCD e outros.

Desde setembro de 2021 temos um programa estruturado para promover a diversidade e um ambiente inclusivo. Temos atuado em governança, engajamento interno e atração e desenvolvimento de talentos com diversidade.

Promovemos conversas e palestras periódicas com pessoas convidadas de outras empresas e líderes de movimentos pro-diversidade.

Instituímos o Comitê de Inclusão e Diversidade que, aliado à alta direção, realizou o levantamento da situação das mulheres na LCA – que têm forte presença na liderança –; o censo de diversidade; e depois de um ano de programa, a pesquisa de inclusão e respeito pessoal e profissional.

Com base no que aprendemos, publicamos o Guia de boas práticas em respeito e inclusão, que você podeconsultar aqui .

Revimos nossas práticas de recrutamento e seleção com vistas a atrair e promover a diversidade. Estamos ativamente buscando pessoas não só de variadas características, como de diversas origens, formações e lugares de morada.

Nos primeiros doze meses do programa conseguimos contratar uma proporção três vezes maior de pessoas negras e LGBT em relação à média anterior – chegando a mais de 30% de representação de cada um desses grupos nas novas contratações.

Nossas pessoas pertencentes a grupos de diversidade recomendam a LCA para pessoas como elas trabalharem –veja aqui um resumo dos resultados da pesquisa. Estamos no começo, temos muito o que aprender e melhorar, e estes primeiros resultados só nos encorajam a seguir em frente.

Sobre Moray
A Moray nasceu com a missão de revolucionar o manejo das culturas agrícolas, reduzindo o uso de insumos e as perdas de produtividade, da planta individual à fazenda inteira. Nos inspiramos nas práticas agrícolas do Império Inca, que já há mil anos operavam com inteligência planta a planta. Hoje, unimos ciência, dados e robótica a um compromisso simples e poderoso: fazer bem-feito, com quem vive o campo.
Nossas soluções otimizam o manejo no campo com precisão, sustentabilidade e impacto real.
Desde o início, contamos com a SLC Agrícola como cliente-âncora e parceira estratégica. Essa parceria moldou nosso jeito de trabalhar: com consistência, respeito e entrega de valor real.
Como um Operations Coordinator, você vai:

  • Coordenar um time de campo para imageamento com drones na agricultura em larga escala.
  • Planejar e acompanhar as atividades de campo seguindo as políticas, procedimentos e instruções da empresa.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas e procedimentos estabelecidos pela ANAC, DECEA, ANATEL, pela equipe de campo.
  • Gestão do processamento digital das imagens georreferenciadas obtidas em campo.
  • Prever, mitigar e gerenciar situações de risco operacional.
  • Acompanhar necessidades dos clientes e executar a logística e planejamento operacional para imageamento de áreas agrícolas

Qualificações requeridas:
  • Ter conhecimento de técnicas de posicionamento por satélite (GNSS).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de georreferenciamento e softwares de GIS (sistema de informação geográfica) tais como QGIS, ArcGIS, Google Earth Engine.
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e apresentação.
  • Compreensão de estatísticas, habilidades analíticas e de processamento de dados.
  • Experiência e habilidade em planejamento.
  • Habilidade de bom relacionamento com o cliente e equipe de campo
  • Vontade e capacidade de experimentar e aprender novas habilidades, tecnologias e ferramentas no trabalho.

Qualificações desejáveis:
  • Experiência com operação de drones classe comercial.
  • Experiência em aerofotogrametria por drone e/ou sensoriamento remoto.
  • Experiência em recursos naturais (agricultura, silvicultura, água, energia).
  • Experiência em áreas de operações com complexidades logísticas.
  • Experiência com operações de produtos baseados em aprendizado de máquina.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem e controle de custos.
  • Conhecimento em ferramenta de monitoramento de tarefas e acompanhamento de projetos, como Jira, Kanban.

Formação acadêmica desejável:
  • Formação superior em Engenharia (qualquer especialidade) ou áreas correlatas com forte base analítica e lógica, como Estatística, Matemática ou Física.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou especialização em Gestão de Operações, Logística, Projetos, Analytics ou Processos será considerado um diferencial.

Join to apply for the Toll Facilities Market Lead role at HDR

At HDR, our employee-owners are fully engaged in creating a welcoming environment where each of us is valued and respected, a place where everyone is empowered to bring their authentic selves and novel ideas to work every day. As we foster a culture of inclusion throughout our company and within our communities, we constantly ask ourselves: What is our impact on the world?
Watch Our Story:' and every role throughout our organization makes a difference in our ability to change the world for the better. Read further to learn how you could help make great things possible not only in your community, but around the world.
Toll Facility Market Lead
As part of HDR’s Highways and Roads market sector, the toll facility market lead will be responsible to support our local areas with the identification and development of projects and programs where HDR can bring our suite of professional services to toll facility clients. Toll facility clients include agencies and authorities that own, operate and maintain roads, bridges and tunnels that charge fees to users that travel on their facilities.
Toll facilities will be a sub-sector to HDR’s highways and roads market sector within the transportation business group. Services that the toll facility market lead will look to bring to these clients include:

  • Planning and Design services including, roadway, bridges, tunnels, transport hydraulics and geotechnical
  • Mobility and operational technology services including ATST, ITS, CAV, tolling system development and operations, managed lanes, ZEM and OT cybersecurity
  • Advisory services including asset management, ROW, value engineering, funding and finance
  • Building and facility design
The toll facility market lead will be responsible for the growth and success of tolling services and programs for toll road clients and will be expected to work with area business development leaders and business group managers to:
  • Develop and share knowledge of trends and drivers within the toll market
  • Support areas in the identification, pursuit and delivery of area toll facility client opportunities where HDR can compete and deliver professional services
  • Support areas in the research of toll facility clients in their markets and help develop client relationships that include local area teams and market sector teams
  • Support TBG region directors in the evaluation and prioritization of toll facility client investments and opportunities across their regions and the business group as the program expands
The toll facility market lead will be an individual with established relationships with toll facility agencies and authorities and someone with a reputation of leading programs in the highway/roads market.
This role will be expected to work with HDR leaders across the business group to broaden the range of toll services offered by HDR and to provide professional development for staff as they provide services to toll facility clients.
The toll facility market lead will be expected to support local area and business group leaders in the identification and participation of industry organizations that will contribute to the growth of HDR with toll facility clients and within the highway and roads market sector.
The toll facility market lead will lead HDR’s strategy for presence and leadership in industry organizations including IBTTA and others.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Recognized Leader in the Toll Roads/Toll Facilities space
  • Proved ability to set the strategy and execute the strategy for growth of a practice, ideally in the Tolling market
  • Established relationships with major tolling clients/DOT's
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree in an architecture, engineering, planning or a related field
  • A minimum of 10 years of industry experience
  • Experienced in development and management of strategic marketing programs for architecture, engineering and or planning services
  • Experienced in development and management of a wide range of client relationships and specific program and/or project pursuits
  • Experienced in overall staff development to include recruiting, career path and professional growth
  • Experienced with industry associations and maintains a visible profile in the market sector
  • Ability to work cooperatively with Area Market Sector Directors, Market Sector Directors, Business Class Directors, Regional Business Group Director, Area Business Group Managers, Area Marketing Managers and Area Managers
  • Demonstrated commitment to HDR values. An attitude and commitment to being an active participant of our employee-owned culture is a must
What We Believe
HDR is our company. Together, we build on each other's life experiences and perspectives to make great things possible every day. This shapes our collaborative culture, encourages organizational trust and connects us closer to the clients and communities we serve.
Our Commitment
As employee owners, we all have a role in creating an inclusive environment where each of us is welcomed, valued, respected and empowered to bring our authentic selves to work every day.
Our eight Employee Network Groups (Asian Pacific, Black, Hispanic/Latino(a), LGBTQ+, People with Disabilities, Veterans, Women, Young Professionals) help create a sense of belonging and foster a supportive environment where everyone is empowered to engage and contribute. Each group has an executive sponsor and is open to all employees.

The Senior Data Engineer will have a crucial role on the Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA) team, an internal, cross-functional analytics team that supports stakeholders across all company’s business units, including Finance, Marketing, Sales, Growth, UX, Customer Success, and Product. The primary responsibility of this role is to drive JumpCloud’s core reporting by developing data pipelines, curating and modeling data, and designing databases to enable insights and self-service across the analytics team and organization.

The Senior Data Engineer will collaborate with analytics teams (EDA, embedded analysts), technical teams (Enterprise Support Systems, Platform Engineering, Software Engineering), and business stakeholders to develop and maintain data pipelines, curated data models, and database designs that will support business and analytics insights throughout the organization.

The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about data and continuous improvement. They will have the ability to balance and prioritize multiple projects, ask insightful questions in an ambiguous environment, and coordinate execution across various stakeholders. A proactive and hands-on approach is essential, as JumpCloud is a lean and fast-moving company.


What you’ll be doing:

Com um bom trabalho e atingindo as metas, é possível dobrar o salário com as bonificações. Depois de um tempo de experiência nesse cargo, voce pode ser promovido ao cargo de Closer, responsável por realizar as chamadas/visitas de venda.

Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Marketing at TRACTIAN:

The Marketing team crafts the narrative, defines messaging and positioning, and translates our groundbreaking products and features into tangible customer benefits. Our cross-functional team, spanning Product Marketing, Customer Experience, Growth, Branding, and Events, is dedicated to acquiring new customers and deeply understanding our business. We collaborate closely with various teams to help our clients reach their full potential.

What you'll do:

As our Content Manager, you’ll drive our regional content strategy from planning to execution. This includes managing our editorial calendar, optimizing performance across channels, and aligning with business goals. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Growth, and Sales to create impactful content supporting inbound acquisition, ABM campaigns, and customer education.

This role combines editorial excellence, technical affinity, and a performance mindset, making it ideal for a hands-on and strategic professional.

Responsibilities

  • Own and manage the content calendar for Brazil across blogs, landing pages, partner media, newsletters, and outbound campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain a pipeline of high-performing content assets supporting awareness, education, and conversion.
  • Lead localization and adaptation of content created by US and MX teams, ensuring cultural and technical relevance.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and Sales to produce BOFU assets like comparison pages, case studies, and playbooks.
  • Support ABM and demand generation with tailored content for target accounts.
  • Track and analyze content performance metrics for future optimization.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders and external partners to scale output without quality loss.
  • Partner with SEO team to ensure content supports growth strategies and keyword opportunities.

Requirements

  • 5+ years managing B2B content, preferably in SaaS or industrial tech.
  • Proven ability to lead editorial planning and coordinate workflows across teams.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, especially in simplifying technical topics.
  • Experience with SEO tools (e.g., Semrush, Ahrefs) and CMS platforms.
  • Data-driven mindset with experience measuring content impact on traffic, leads, and pipeline.
  • Highly autonomous, organized, and deadline-oriented.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Compensation:

  • Competitive salary and stock options.
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.
  • 30 days of paid annual leave.
  • Education and courses stipend.

  • Up to R$1,000/month for meals and remote work allowance.
  • Health plan with national coverage without coparticipation.
  • Dental insurance for improved quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/month extra for activities.

Na MCS Markup todas as oportunidades são aderentes à diversidade e abertas a pessoas com deficiência! Valorizamos a singularidade de cada indivíduo e acreditamos que a inclusão enriquece nosso ambiente de trabalho.
Se você busca um espaço onde suas habilidades e potencial sejam reconhecidos, esta é a sua chance! Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que preza pela diversidade e pela igualdade.
Sobre a vaga:
Buscamos Consultor (a) de Due Diligence Sênior, para atuar em nosso time no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo ou Remoto para demais localidades.
Requisitos e qualificações:
O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Graduação concluída em Ciências Contábeis ou Administração;
  • Conhecimento no pacote office, com ênfase em Excel Intermediário/Avançado;

Sendo diferencial, vivencia anterior em big4 e/ou consultoria.

  • Atuar em projetos de Due Diligence contábil/financeira relacionados a potenciais transações de compra e/ou venda de empresas;
  • Analisar demonstrações financeiras, indicadores operacionais e dados contábeis com foco em entender a performance histórica, qualidade dos resultados (EBITDA ajustado), capital de giro, endividamento, entre outros;
  • Conduzir reuniões com clientes, investidores e empresas-alvo para levantamento de informações e esclarecimento de dúvidas;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time técnico, delegando tarefas de forma eficaz e gerenciando a equipe nos projetos;
  • Revisar os trabalhos técnicos realizados pela equipe, reportando os principais pontos ao gerente e ao sócio responsável;

Inscrição: Inicie sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro. Fique tranquilo(a), nossa equipe irá analisar as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Entrevista com Recursos Humanos: Você terá a oportunidade de dialogar com nosso time de Atração de Talentos;
Seleção. O objetivo é nos conhecermos melhor e garantir que nossos valores e abordagens estejam alinhados com suas crenças e expectativas.

Company Summary:

Recurrent Energy is a wholly owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and is one of the world's largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and O&M platforms. Recurrent Energy is focused on bringing low-cost clean energy and meaningful economic development to communities across the globe.

At Recurrent Energy, we believe in the power of teamwork to create a sustainable future. Join us as we work together toward a cleaner, greener tomorrow.

Reports To: Sr. Manager, Project Engineering

Location: Flexible hybrid model from our offices in São Paulo. In addition, traveling may be required to project sites.

Position Summary:

Recurrent Energy is comprised of an innovative, passionate, and hard-working team that is committed to making a difference and transforming the world with clean electricity. People are what make the company stand out. As a Project Engineer, you demonstrate the perfect combination of technical expertise and project management savvy.

You will lead the development, coordination and review of designs and technical standards for Recurrent Energy’s utility scale solar and BESS projects. At the core, as a Project Engineer you are an expert coordinator, bringing together stakeholders of every level for effective and profitable project deliveries.

Responsibilities:

Design Oversight

  • Develop, coordinate development, and review designs for Recurrent Energy projects (including permitting and construction support, customer care, and sales support).
  • Manage the work of engineering services providers and consultants.
  • Establish, maintain and improve technical specifications for Recurrent Energy facilities and equipment.
  • Provide technical support for interconnection in collaboration with transmission engineering team.
  • Support the performance and LCOE optimization process of Recurrent Energy projects.
  • Complete technical site assessment reviews and pre-design site visits.

Construction Support

  • Lead technical oversight during design and construction phases of the project, including value added engineering consistent with the required project specifications and requirements.
  • Provide engineering and QA/QC support to the project management team during project construction and commissioning.
  • Provide technical direction during startup, testing, PV system commissioning and performance monitoring.
  • Provide technical support for the review/preparation of client proposals and EPC/equipment RFP packages.
  • Participate in the evaluation and selection of EPC and main equipment suppliers.
  • Participate in the preparation, review, and negotiations of the technical exhibits for project sales, equipment procurement and EPC contracting agreements.
  • Attend factory acceptance tests for HV and electrical equipment.
  • Evaluation of PV products, emerging technologies and best practices in the solar EPC field.
  • Collectively responsible for project budgets of $100 – 500 million
  • Communicate and influence cross-functionally within Recurrent Energy.
  • Responsible for consultant scopes and associated costs.

Reporting Relationships & Interactions

  • Works cross functionally and collaboratively with all departments.
  • Manages consultant work orders to ensure scope, schedule, quality and coordination requirements are met.
  • Interfaces with third-party engineering service providers, and subcontractors.

Abilities

  • Problem solving skills: takes a systematic and proactive approach to solving problems. Actively seeks out issues rather than reacting to them as they come up.
  • Self-development: knows own capabilities, seeks out feedback and responds positively to constructive criticism.
  • Critical thinking: can break a situation down into smaller pieces to identify its key or underlying issues.
  • Flexibility: has the ability to work in a variety of situations, and with various individuals and groups. Understanding and appreciating different and opposing perspectives on an issue and adapting one’s approach to the changes at hand.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual will perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in an Engineering or Technical field.
  • 3-5 years of progressive experience with engineering. procurement and construction of utility scale solar PV systems.
  • Extensive knowledge of IEEE and other governing standards for design of solar PV systems.
  • Knowledge of solar and BESS project engineering, procurement, and construction processes.
  • Knowledge of engineering economics and design optimization.
  • Knowledge of project contract terms including PPAs, interconnection agreements and real estate.
  • In depth knowledge of either DC/AC electrical systems, HV equipment, civil design or SAT structural design/calculations for utility scale solar projects.
  • Professional Engineer or equivalent regulatory body license is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of basic computer skills.
  • Travel to project sites when needed.
  • Bilingual with Portuguese and English.

At Recurrent Energy, we are committed to fostering career growth and development. As a Project Engineer, you will be an individual contributor who must manage complex schedules and meet deadlines, navigate a variety of personalities, and stay on (or under) budgets. Your manager will help you advance your career in a way that suits your goals and strengths.

Recurrent Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE).Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

We own several services that, combined, serve more than 1 million requests per minute. We know this number will only grow, and we're looking for engineers that can help with the challenges of developing backend systems that perform well at a large scale.

What you’ll do

description:
